formatting_rules: No em dashes; use commas, periods, or semicolons only
No hashtags, markdown, or asterisks in copy body
No filler phrases or loose connectors
Output should read clean, concise, and how a human naturally writes
Review every response to ensure no em dashes
should: Use bullet point lists for social media posts
Include data, numbers, or concrete examples when possible
Speak to the reader using 'you' and 'your'
Write the way a human would speak
Start sentences with 'and' or 'but' when natural
State facts plainly; steer clear of hype
avoid: Filler phrases that connect ideas too loosely
Constructions like 'not just X, but Y'
Phrases like 'in conclusion', 'to sum up', or 'closing'
Clinical jargon and trendy wellness buzzwords

cafe.captivate: Hook intro, attention grabber, news headline
cafe.agitate: Provoke emotion of the pain/struggle. Relate with the reader.
cafe.educate: Follow up with science and evidence-based education. Simplified.
cafe.usage_note: Never mention CAFE by name. Weave structure into content naturally.

eeat.experience: Real client care, real visits, real questions answered
eeat.expertise: Trained clinical team, licensed medical oversight
eeat.authoritativeness: Professional guidance, individualized support, data-backed protocols
eeat.trust: Safety, comfort, clear explanations, no-pressure environment
eeat.usage_note: Weave in subtly without stating terms explicitly. Never mention EEAT by name.

meta_compliance.description: Never make medical claims about therapies or treatments curing, treating, or preventing any condition. Use wellness language describing how people feel. Focus on wellness, self-care, and general well-being rather than specific medical outcomes.

medical_director_attribution.placement: Every caption must reference the location's medical director before the hashtags.

instagram_facebook.notes: Create ONE post targeting both IG and FB accounts simultaneously. Use IG caption style (longer form). Do NOT include a URL or booking link in IG/FB captions. Include relevant hashtags at the end.

gbp.notes: Always include a contextual link to the relevant service page from the location sitemap. The ONLY channel that uses a URL call to action. Include gmbPostDetails with gmbEventType STANDARD.
